_doc: the agents are libraries of the root, pinned here like package.json pins its dependencies. `rev` is a tag, a branch or a sha of the agent's own repo. main of the root pins release tags; a release/<version> branch pins what the version is being built on. `links` are the ignored files a root worktree borrows from the working copy (scripts/agents sync). Read and written by shared/agents_lock.py only; see README, 'Versions and the agents' checkout'. CF-0651: `modules` are pinned the same way but are no part of a batch - the command center (`frontend`, repo example/command-center); sync builds it (`build`: npm ci && npm run build -> frontend/dist) under the root's API `contract`, status only warns about it.
